title: C++ Date and Time
description: Dates and times in C++: <ctime>, time_t and struct tm, time(), localtime and gmtime, strftime formatting, clock() and difftime, the Unix epoch, and the basics of <chrono>.

descriptionI18n.zh-Hant: C++ 的日期與時間：<ctime>、time_t 與 struct tm、time()、localtime 與 gmtime、strftime 格式化、clock() 與 difftime、Unix 紀元，以及 <chrono> 的基礎。

questions.prompt: Which header declares `time_t`, `struct tm` and the function `std::time`?

prompt.zh-Hant: 哪一個標頭檔宣告了 `time_t`、`struct tm` 與函式 `std::time`？

explanation.zh-Hant: <ctime> 是 C 標準 <time.h> 的 C++ 版本，提供 time_t、tm、time、localtime、strftime 等；<chrono> 則是另一套型別安全的時間程式庫。

options.text: <ctime>
<chrono>
<datetime>
<date>

questions.explanation: `<ctime>` is the C++ wrapper around C's `<time.h>` and declares `time_t`, `struct tm`, `time`, `localtime`, `strftime` and friends. `<chrono>` is a separate, type-safe time library.

questions.prompt: A `time_t` value obtained from `std::time` typically counts what, and from which instant?

prompt.zh-Hant: 由 `std::time` 取得的 `time_t` 值通常計算甚麼，並以哪個時刻為起點？

a.zh-Hant: 自 Unix 紀元（1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC）以來的秒數

b.zh-Hant: 自 Unix 紀元以來的毫秒數

c.zh-Hant: 自 1900 年以來的奈秒數

d.zh-Hant: 自開機以來的時鐘滴答數

explanation.zh-Hant: time_t 通常是以秒為單位的 Unix 時間戳，起點是 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC；實際型別由實作決定，但語意是日曆時間。

options.text: Seconds since the Unix epoch, 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC
Milliseconds since the Unix epoch
Nanoseconds since 1900
Clock ticks since the machine booted

questions.explanation: A `time_t` from `std::time` is normally a Unix timestamp in seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC. The exact underlying type is implementation-defined, but the meaning is calendar time.

a.zh-Hant: 目前的日曆時間，型別為 time_t

b.zh-Hant: 目前的時間，型別為 struct tm

c.zh-Hant: 程式已使用的處理器時間

d.zh-Hant: 目前時區與 UTC 的秒差

explanation.zh-Hant: time() 傳回 time_t；傳 nullptr 表示不另外儲存結果。要得到 tm 必須再呼叫 localtime 或 gmtime。

options.text: The current calendar time as a `time_t`
The current time as a `struct tm`
The processor time the program has used
The offset in seconds between the local zone and UTC

questions.explanation: `time` returns a `time_t`; passing `nullptr` means the result is not also stored through the pointer. You must call `localtime` or `gmtime` to obtain a `tm`.

a.zh-Hant: 依格式字串把 struct tm 格式化到呼叫端提供的字元緩衝區

b.zh-Hant: 讀取系統時鐘並傳回 time_t

c.zh-Hant: 把 time_t 轉成本地時間並傳回 tm 指標

d.zh-Hant: 測量程式消耗的處理器時間

explanation.zh-Hant: strftime(buffer, size, "%Y-%m-%d", &tm) 依格式規格輸出；b、c 分別是 time 與 localtime，d 是 clock。

options.text: Format a `struct tm` into a caller-supplied character buffer using a format string
Read the system clock and return a `time_t`
Convert a `time_t` to local time and return a `tm` pointer
Measure the processor time consumed by the program

questions.explanation: `strftime(buffer, size, "%Y-%m-%d", &tm)` writes a formatted string into your buffer; b is `time`, c is `localtime`, and d is `clock`.

questions.prompt: Which of these are members of `struct tm`? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列哪些是 `struct tm` 的成員？可多選。

explanation.zh-Hant: tm 的成員是 tm_year（自 1900 起）、tm_mon（0–11）、tm_mday（1–31）、tm_hour、tm_min、tm_sec；沒有 tm_seconds 這個成員。

options.text: `tm_year`, the years since 1900
`tm_mon`, the month where 0 means January
`tm_mday`, the day of the month from 1 to 31
`tm_seconds`, the seconds from 0 to 59

questions.explanation: `struct tm` has `tm_year` (years since 1900), `tm_mon` (0–11), `tm_mday` (1–31), `tm_hour`, `tm_min` and `tm_sec`. There is no member called `tm_seconds`.

questions.prompt: Which statements about `std::localtime` and `std::gmtime` are true? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 關於 `std::localtime` 與 `std::gmtime`，下列哪些敘述正確？可多選。

a.zh-Hant: 兩者都傳回指向靜態 tm 物件的指標，內容可能被下一次呼叫覆寫

b.zh-Hant: localtime 套用本地時區，gmtime 傳回 UTC

c.zh-Hant: 兩者都是執行緒安全，每次呼叫都傳回全新的緩衝區

d.zh-Hant: 轉換失敗時可能傳回空指標

explanation.zh-Hant: 標準版本共用一個靜態 tm，後續呼叫會覆寫它（執行緒安全版本是 localtime_r、gmtime_r）；localtime 依時區換算，gmtime 為 UTC，失敗時傳回 nullptr。

options.text: Both return a pointer to a static `tm` that a later call may overwrite
`localtime` applies the local time zone; `gmtime` returns UTC
Both are thread-safe and return a fresh buffer on every call
They may return a null pointer if the conversion fails

questions.explanation: The standard functions share a static `tm` that subsequent calls may overwrite; the reentrant variants are `localtime_r` and `gmtime_r`. `localtime` converts to the local zone, `gmtime` to UTC, and both may return `nullptr` on failure.

questions.prompt: `std::asctime` formats a `struct tm` with a caller-supplied format string such as "%Y-%m-%d".

prompt.zh-Hant: `std::asctime` 會用呼叫端提供的格式字串（例如 "%Y-%m-%d"）來格式化 `struct tm`。

explanation.zh-Hant: asctime 使用固定的 "Www Mmm dd hh:mm:ss yyyy\n" 格式並回傳靜態緩衝區；自訂格式要用 strftime。ctime 則是 asctime(localtime(&t)) 的簡便形式。

questions.explanation: `asctime` always uses the fixed `"Www Mmm dd hh:mm:ss yyyy\n"` form and returns a pointer to a static buffer; custom formats belong to `strftime`. `ctime` is shorthand for `asctime(localtime(&t))`.

questions.prompt: `std::clock()` measures the processor time consumed by the program, not wall-clock elapsed time.

prompt.zh-Hant: `std::clock()` 測量的是程式消耗的處理器時間，而不是牆鐘經過的時間。

explanation.zh-Hant: clock 傳回 CPU 時間的滴答數，除以 CLOCKS_PER_SEC 得到秒數；若要牆鐘時間應使用 <chrono> 的 steady_clock。

questions.explanation: `clock` returns processor-time ticks; divide by `CLOCKS_PER_SEC` for seconds. For wall-clock elapsed time use `std::chrono::steady_clock`.

questions.prompt: The standard function that returns the difference in seconds between two `time_t` values as a `double` is `std::____`.

prompt.zh-Hant: 計算兩個 `time_t` 之間相差秒數（以 `double` 傳回）的標準函式是 `std::____`。

explanation.zh-Hant: difftime(end, begin) 傳回 double 秒數；直接相減雖然也可行，但 difftime 是可攜且語意清楚的寫法。

questions.explanation: `difftime(end, begin)` returns the difference in seconds as a `double`. Subtracting the values directly usually works too, but `difftime` states the intent and is portable.

questions.prompt: Define the Unix epoch, and explain the difference between `std::chrono::system_clock` and `std::chrono::steady_clock`.

prompt.zh-Hant: 說明甚麼是 Unix 紀元，並解釋 `std::chrono::system_clock` 與 `std::chrono::steady_clock` 的差別。

model.zh-Hant: Unix 紀元是 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC，Unix 時間戳就是自此之後經過的秒數（不含閏秒）。system_clock 對應系統的日曆時間，可以轉成 time_t、顯示日期，但可能被校時或使用者調整而跳動；steady_clock 則是單調遞增、不會倒退的時鐘，適合量測經過時間。因此「現在幾點」用 system_clock，「計時」用 steady_clock。

explanation.zh-Hant: 關鍵在於兩種時鐘的用途：日曆時間可被調整，單調時鐘只保證往前走的穩定性。

answer.model: The Unix epoch is 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC; a Unix timestamp counts the seconds elapsed since then (ignoring leap seconds). `system_clock` tracks calendar time, converts to `time_t` and can display dates, but it may jump when the system clock is corrected or changed. `steady_clock` is monotonic and never goes backwards, so it is the right choice for measuring elapsed time.

questions.explanation: The distinction is purpose: calendar time can be adjusted, while a monotonic clock only guarantees forward progress.
